Container.Name: DailyNotes
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted daily task and note-taking app. Markdown with GitHub Flavored Markdown task lists, tags, projects, search, Kanban board, and all notes encrypted at rest.
API_SECRET_KEY and DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY are generated automatically and stored in the appdata folder if left blank. If you set DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY yourself, never change it afterwards or existing notes can no longer be decrypted.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the DailyNotes web interface.

Config.Name: API_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Signs login tokens. Generated automatically if blank.

Config.Name: DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY
Config.Description: Encrypts notes at rest. Generated automatically if blank. WARNING: never change it after first start.

Config.Name: PREVENT_SIGNUPS
Config.Description: Set to any value to disable new user signups.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URI
Config.Description: Optional PostgreSQL/MySQL connection string. Uses SQLite in /app/config if blank.

Config.Name: DEFAULT_TIMEZONE
Config.Description: TZ name (e.g. America/Denver) for external ICS calendar events.

Config.Name: APP_URL
Config.Description: Public URL of this instance, used in email links.

Config.Name: SMTP_HOST
Config.Description: SMTP server for password reset and magic link emails. Email features disabled if blank.
